tests.description: A handler function inside a block argument reads the block parameter and writes a node variable. Same on main.
A handler function inside a handler function. This one fails on main: the inner handle block is skipped on the outer handler's second run (outer=1 inner=11,inner=11,inner=0).
An inner handler that rejects one interrupt and passes on the other, under an outer with approve. Same on main.
The on-clause form of a handler function. Same on main.
A JavaScript error thrown in a handler function travels up and `try` turns it into a failure. Same on main.
A validated alias and a generic alias declared in the enclosing node are visible in the handler function: the validator runs and the generic alias compiles, as in any block.
